title: Compressor-01 Drive-End Bearing Vibration & Fatigue Response
steps: Acknowledge high vibration alarm ALM-C01-VB on Compressor-01 supervisory console.
Check drive-end vibration transmitter CMP-01-VIB spectrum against 7.0 mm/s shutdown limit.
Monitor bearing temperature CMP-01-TMP trend; if temperature exceeds 85.0 °C, initiate controlled deceleration.
Check motor stator current CMP-01-CUR to assess mechanical drag from bearing seizure.
Engage auxiliary lube oil cooling pump and inspect bearing oil supply pressure.
If vibration does not drop below 2.8 mm/s baseline, trip compressor and dispatch maintenance for mechanical bearing inspection.
